summary: Ambient light, motion and device usage are read by the shell. The research reader is gated by Apple-issued entitlements, and the Watch and face sensors are hardware the target devices lack.
rea_evidence: not captured: REA capture pending (tools/parity/rea-page.sh not run in this batch); facts are from tools/parity/docc.py

features.note: gated by an Apple-approved research study entitlement; BifrOSt has no such approval path
ambient light model in the core and the UI; not exposed to apps through a sensor reader
samples held in a bounded log; no SensorKit-style fetch request
per-app usage counted by the shell; the report is not handed to apps
needs Apple Watch or face sensing hardware that the target devices lack

gaps: No research reader or fetch requests for apps.
Usage reports stay in the shell.
